scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @empire/api" "npm run dev -w @empire/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @empire/api && npm run build -w @empire/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @empire/api && npm run typecheck -w @empire/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w @empire/api && npm run db:seed -w @empire/api
